## Description

MediaRecorder capture in browser: large REC timer, pause/resume, stop, waveform (static with reduced motion), consent pill always visible, live provisional transcript panel (if supported, marked provisional, never auto-entering the record). Mobile: screen stays awake (Wake Lock), lock-screen/notification shows recording indicator without PHI. Battery and network warnings. Low audio warning (A-06d) if levels too low.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Start/pause/stop transitions follow the capture FSM and are mirrored server-side.
- [ ] **AC2.** The recording indicator and timer are visible at all times during capture, including on mobile.
- [ ] **AC3.** No PHI appears in OS notifications or the page title while recording.
- [ ] **AC4.** Warnings appear for battery < 20 %, offline/poor network and low audio level, each with text guidance.
- [ ] **AC5.** Works on current Chrome/Edge desktop, Android Chrome and iOS Safari (tested matrix recorded).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
